text.p: Britain's Imperial Chemical Industries Plc said on Thursday it restructured executive responsibilities to increase the focus on units' performance.
The company said chief executive Charles Miller Smith would focus on groupwide issues, while three business directors would concentrate on certain divisions, effective from April 1.

Executive director Rob Margetts will be the director for ICI's Industrial Chemicals Business, including its chemicals and polymers and titanium dioxide (Tioxide) operations, which the company plans to float.
Finance director Alan Spall told Reuters in an interview that ICI planned to float Tioxide in the next 18 months.
The company also said it would name a business director for its Materials and Performance Chemicals operations, which include acrylics and polyurethanes.
Among other changes, the company said Peter Kirby, CEO of ICI Paints, was named Coatings Business director.
Executive director Mike Brogden will retire on June 30, the company said in a statement.
